name: Temporary Residence for Family Reunification

requirement_groups.name: Direct family member of a resident

requirements.blocker_text: Ley Especial de Migracion y Extranjeria, Article 81: 'residentes temporales por matrimonio o union' (temporary residence for marriage or civil union) is a named authorized category. Separately, El Salvador's migration authority confirms that having direct family members who already hold resident status in the country is itself a recognized basis for a foreigner to pursue temporary residence.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for temporary residence as the spouse, civil-union partner, or direct family member of a Salvadoran resident, submitting the application form for that category.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or proof of civil union
Proof of relationship for other direct family members

sources.title: SELA (Latin American and Caribbean Economic System) -- hosted primary legal text of El Salvador's Ley Especial de Migracion y Extranjeria, Article 81 (authorized temporary-residence categories including marriage/union)
Direccion General de Migracion y Extranjeria de El Salvador -- confirms 'direct family members who are residents' as a recognized temporary-residence category
